newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile's Enap to sign oil deal with Canada firm.
newsitem.headline: Chile's Enap to sign oil deal with Canada firm.

text.p: Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (Enap) said it will sign a $15 million deal with Canadian firm Cordex Petroleum Inc. to carry out oil exploration in the far southern Straits of Magellan.
The agreement to explore an area known as Bloque Fell will last for 35 years, said the statement.
If the companies find commercially viable oil or natural gas fields, they will be exploited by a joint venture owned 55 percent by Codex with the rest held by Enap.
Chile's only known oil and natural gas reserves are found in the icy straits which lie close to Cape Horn.
Enap recently signed a pact with U.S. company Evergreen Resources to explore for oil in the northern Atacama Desert.
